<a id="dev_clear_part_ptrs"></a>
### [`dev_clear_part_ptrs`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_12ed.asm#L6) `$12ED`

*routine*

Unreferenced development code, the same bytes as v1 $1354. It writes 0 to fighter_part_ptrs $02-$13, so all parts show the blank sprite. No code calls it.

- **Writes:** [`fighter_part_ptrs+16`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_part_ptrs), [`fighter_part_ptrs+17`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_part_ptrs)
